name: HDMS
summary: HDMS was a historical WIMP experiment using concentric germanium crystals to reduce low-energy backgrounds. Heidelberg refers to the research team; the detector actually operated at LNGS.
detection_principle: The inner germanium crystal is the primary target; the outer crystal vetoes multiply scattered photons. Low-energy ionization is recorded. The final detector replaced the inner crystal with enriched 73Ge.

key_parameters.name: Core structure
key_parameters.value: Two concentric Ge crystals in a single cryostat

results.summary: Background performance and dark-matter searches with the final enriched-germanium configuration were reported.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
